name: University of Zurich
summary: Public university in Zurich, from law and medicine to informatics; its bachelor's are taught in German, and you need a German C1 certificate.

ib.text: swissuniversities IB rule: 32/42 (2026/27), six subjects, three HL incl. maths or a science; Psychology, ESS, Global Politics and the arts don't count. German C1 certificate needed.

dates.label: Autumn-semester application opens (same date every year)
Application closes if you need no visa; cannot be extended (same date every year)
Application closes if you need a Swiss study visa (same date every year)

notes: The extended window to 31 July is only for Swiss school certificates, so with an IB your deadline is 30 April.
You can start only once you meet the language requirement, and checking a complete application can take up to three months.
Medicine also needs a registration with swissuniversities by 15 February.
